assembly_notes: Run: python scripts/ensure_models_assets.py --full       (downloads all including large models)
Run: ENSURE_MODELS=1 bash scripts/test_pipeline.sh       (CI path, respects ci_skip)
IndicConformer must be assembled BEFORE flutter build — it is resolved from assets/models/indic_conformer/ at runtime
Future: python scripts/ensure_models_assets.py --profile rtx5090  will select 600M INT8 IndicConformer compiled on user RTX 5090
